def operation_probe(code, task):
    tree = ast.parse(code)
    nodes = list(ast.walk(tree))
    if task == "identity":
        calls = {n.targets[0].id: n.value for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name)}
        return all(isinstance(calls.get(name), ast.Call) and isinstance(calls[name].func, ast.Name) and calls[name].func.id == "Order" for name in ("first", "second")) and any(isinstance(n, ast.Compare) and isinstance(n.left, ast.Name) and n.left.id == "first" and isinstance(n.ops[0], ast.Is) and isinstance(n.comparators[0], ast.Name) and n.comparators[0].id == "second" for n in nodes)

    if task == "binary":

import shutil

import contextlib

import io

import json

import csv

import builtins

import ast


def prepare_case(inputs):
    pathlib.Path("source.bin").write_bytes(inputs["content"].encode("utf-8"))
    pathlib.Path("copy.bin").write_text("Disposable destination")
    return inputs

def check_case(inputs):
    prepared = prepare_case(inputs)
    ns = dict(globals())
    ns.update(inputs)
    ns.update(prepared or {})
    source_code = pathlib.Path("main.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    code = source_code.split("# BEGIN " + "LEARNER\n", 1)[1].split("# END " + "LEARNER", 1)[0]
    captured = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(captured):
        exec(code, ns)
    return [list(pathlib.Path("source.bin").read_bytes()), list(pathlib.Path("copy.bin").read_bytes()), ns["source"].closed, ns["destination"].closed, type(ns["payload"]).__name__] + [operation_probe(code, 'binary')]

def operation_probe(code, task):
    tree = ast.parse(code)
    nodes = list(ast.walk(tree))
    if task == "identity":
        calls = {n.targets[0].id: n.value for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name)}
        return all(isinstance(calls.get(name), ast.Call) and isinstance(calls[name].func, ast.Name) and calls[name].func.id == "Order" for name in ("first", "second")) and any(isinstance(n, ast.Compare) and isinstance(n.left, ast.Name) and n.left.id == "first" and isinstance(n.ops[0], ast.Is) and isinstance(n.comparators[0], ast.Name) and n.comparators[0].id == "second" for n in nodes)
    if task == "exclusive":
        opens = [n for n in nodes if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Name) and n.func.id == "open"]
        return len(opens) == 1 and len(opens[0].args) > 1 and isinstance(opens[0].args[1], ast.Constant) and opens[0].args[1].value == "x" and any(isinstance(n, ast.ExceptHandler) and isinstance(n.type, ast.Name) and n.type.id == "FileExistsError" for n in nodes)
    if task == "managed":
        return sum(isinstance(n, ast.With) for n in nodes) == 2 and not any(isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr == "close" for n in nodes)
    if task == "binary":
        outer = next((n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.With)), None)
        inner = next((n for n in outer.body if isinstance(n, ast.With)), None) if outer else None
        return inner is not None and any(isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr == "write" and len(n.args) == 1 and isinstance(n.args[0], ast.Name) and n.args[0].id == "payload" for n in ast.walk(inner)) and not any(isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr in ("decode", "encode", "close") for n in nodes)
    return True
')
